reviewer: Separate-context AI reviewer, not a human ground-truth oracle.
oracle_limit: These are separate-context AI judgments derived from discussion text and logic; not human ground truth, source-derived tests or proof of universal behavior.
authorship: Authored after demand freeze and proposal review, before any candidate code inspection or source execution.

cases.scope: Nonnegative integral length and positive integral size; batch count only.

justification.quotation: number_of_batches = full_batches if rest == 0 else full_batches + 1
justification.reason: One partial batch for 1/5; quotient 2 remainder 1 for 7/3; exact quotient 2 for 6/3; nine unit-sized batches. Arithmetic derived independently without running the quoted code.

limitations: Does not test randomization, permutation construction or indexing.
Passing is not proof batch count is an unmet standalone need.

cases.scope: Valid single cookie name repeated with uncomplicated unquoted token values; adopts proposal's displayed-string convention only.

justification.quotation: only use the first instance of duplicate
justification.reason: First occurrence supplies retained value regardless of further repetitions; renaming one cookie/token does not alter this stated policy. Display prefix follows the explicit SimpleCookie printed example in comment 1094014535.

limitations: Independent derivation still conditional on the model's printed-string representation.
No new expectations for attributes, malformed syntax, multiple-name sorting or repeated load calls.
Not evidence of accepted upstream policy or RFC-wide compliance.

cases.scope: Ordinary Windows path forms; fully qualified definition chosen in later discussion, independent of host OS.

justification.reason: UNC share and drive-root paths identify both device and root; root-only lacks drive/device; plain relative lacks both; drive-relative lacks a root. Later fully-qualified interpretation is explicit in comment 1881752389.

limitations: No malformed/device namespace or mixed-separator edge grammar invented.
Fixture checks a reported-fixed operation and cannot show new unmet demand or containment safety.

abstentions.reason: No independently grounded exact expected option array: maximum assignment policy, ordering, false-condition behavior and threshold semantics require choices not settled by discussion. Final locs=0 report lacks corresponding observed maxima, so encoding it as a synthetic args fixture would invent data.
Proposal abstained; no argument/expected representation to preserve. Do not invent an executable contract to force a challenge.
